_: Applies to EVERY tts provider. Voice-specific respellings belong in content/pronounce.<provider>.json — see pronounce.edge.json.
_honorific: written short on screen, said in full by the voice. (রাঃ) male, (রাহাঃ) female. ঃ is a combining mark, so রাঃ and রা are different words and both need an entry.
